mechanism: Ciprofloxacin inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP1A2, potentially increasing modafinil plasma concentrations; modafinil may also induce CYP3A4, creating bidirectional interaction potential.
action: Monitor for modafinil toxicity signs (headache, insomnia, anxiety, tachycardia); consider modafinil dose reduction if used concurrently with ciprofloxacin; ensure adequate hydration and renal monitoring.
